purpose: Return the source rating for one exact chemical/service row and one material column.
lookup_sequence: exact concentration, temperature and condition wording
material temperature column where explicitly provided
source note and inline qualifier review

temperature_rules.linear_polyethylene_and_polypropylene: Use only the source column matching 68°F or 140°F. Do not interpolate or extrapolate.
temperature_rules.other_materials: No general material-column temperature is stated. Apply only chemical-row and note conditions explicitly printed in the source.

prohibited_actions: Do not automatically select a vessel plate, pipe, forging, fitting or bolting grade.
Do not treat an A rating as ASME Code approval.
Do not calculate corrosion allowance from this chart.
Do not replace a corrosion or materials-selection study.
Do not treat a dash, blank, V or undefined N as acceptable.
Do not hide source notes or qualifiers.
